03900b331d575abc8207f2f31536cb3209c19ef4.compatibilityConsequence: TS consumers cannot subscribe to stream-progress frames (StreamStarted/StreamDelta/StreamAborted) and cannot correlate a durable event id with a streamed slot; upstream's streaming surface is absent.
